title: Catherine de Médicis to Villeroy, Chenonceau, 7–8 Feb 1581, BnF fr. 15564 ff. 30–34, cipher block on f. 33r (DECODE R4157, catalogued as unknown sender, 5 Feb 1587)

steps.what: DECODE R4157 images downloaded with the cookie; found to be Gallica openings of fr. 15564 ff. 30–34 plus a crop of the cipher block; full-resolution views fetched from Gallica IIIF.
Docket read: 'Double de la lettre de la Royne mere du Roy à Mr de Villeroy'; content (Anjou and the Low Countries, Condé's troops) and 'Chenonceau' point to Feb 1581, not 1587.
Lettres de Catherine de Médicis t. IX (1586–88) searched for a 5 Feb 1587 letter to Villeroy.
t. VII (1579–81): letter found, pp. 349–353, 'Orig. fonds français 15564 f° 30', cipher printed as its marginal decipherment.
First-pass sign labels of the eight cipher lines (tokens_v1.txt, 290 tokens, 66 labels).
One sign per letter against the printed crib: windowed consistency test, fixed-pair (two signs per letter) test, parity test.
EM alignment and simulated annealing (letter or null per sign type) against the 148-letter printed crib: best 63 errors; the crib was only half the plaintext.
Tomokiyo's cryptiana page on Charles IX / Henry III ciphers has a reconstructed key for fr. 15564 f. 33, last line unread.
Mapped first-pass labels onto Tomokiyo's key: the block reads, including the passage deciphered at the time under the block.
Second pass at 2x zoom splitting merged look-alike signs (ψ/ɣ, ᴀ/Δ, ϖ/ʊ/&, ɦ/б, v/V, ʒ/Ʒ); tokens.txt, key.tsv.
Twelve values added from context: 18 = dict, C̄σ = mais, ß̄ = la, ō = Angleterre, 4/b = nous (not vous), ℬ = p, ꝏ = u, ꝑ = t, ψ = n, ᴀ and & = z, F̣ = i.

Last line: 20 signs after 'd ō' tested as text; they contain the declared null Z7 twice and the start-of-block padding signs, give no French, and the decipherer and f. 33v's clear text both end the passage there: padding.
Reading compared with the contemporary decipherment and the edition: agrees except 'et non devant', 'ne laisserons de le nommer', 'Monpensier'.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's reconstructed key for BnF fr. 15564 f. 33 (cryptiana, Charles IX/Henry III ciphers) was applied and extended by twelve values; the contemporary marginal decipherment on the page and the 1899 edition (Lettres de Catherine de Medicis VII) were used as the check.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt tally over tokens.txt: 262 message signs read as sense (3 graded M), 27 nulls and end padding; 289 of 289 tokens accounted for

gaps.item: ō = Angleterre, single occurrence, graded M
latin e after the de code in Condé: e/é or null
missing r of 'pouoir' at the end of line 6

outcome.notes: Read in full with Tomokiyo's key extended; the contemporary decipherment and the 1899 edition agree. DECODE's metadata (unknown sender, 5 Feb 1587) corrected to Catherine de Médicis → Villeroy, 7 Feb 1581.

prior.where: Contemporary decipherment on the page; printed as plain text in Lettres de Catherine de Médicis t. VII (1899); key reconstructed by Tomokiyo (cryptiana, date unknown), last line unread, no plaintext published. Also in print (1899) and a published key (Tomokiyo).

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the catalogue entry. No target-specific intervention recorded.
